numbering: Episodes numbered 1-12 in broadcast order; Rebellion and Walpurgisnacht: Rising are films with no episode numbers.

arcs.name: Mami's Arc
arcs.summary: Middle-schooler Madoka meets Kyubey and the veteran magical girl Mami, who offers to show her what the job is like.
events: Madoka and Sayaka meet Kyubey and transfer student Homura.
Mami shows them how to hunt witches.
Mami is killed by the witch Charlotte.

arcs.name: Sayaka's Arc
arcs.summary: Sayaka makes a contract for someone she loves, and the cost of magic becomes clear.
events: Sayaka contracts to heal Kyosuke's hand.
It's revealed that Soul Gems hold the girls' souls.
Sayaka becomes a witch, and Kyoko gives her life to stop her.

arcs.name: Homura's Past
arcs.summary: A flashback shows where Homura really comes from.
events: Homura is a time traveller who has repeated the same month many times to save Madoka.

arcs.name: Walpurgisnacht
arcs.summary: The great witch Walpurgisnacht arrives, and Madoka must decide whether to contract.
events: Madoka wishes to erase witches before they're born, becoming a concept that rewrites the universe.

arcs.name: Rebellion
arcs.summary: The magical girls live a cheerful life in a Mitakihara that feels slightly off.
events: Homura realises the world is a barrier inside her Soul Gem.
Homura seizes part of Madoka's power and becomes a demon who rewrites the world.

arcs.name: Walpurgisnacht: Rising
arcs.summary: The sequel film continuing the story after Rebellion, premiered on 28 August 2026.
events: Continues on from Homura's rewriting of the world at the end of Rebellion.
Released in Japanese theatres on 28 August 2026 after several delays.

filler.note: Anime original, so there's no filler.
